name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 56 - Am 163
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 56d. Urges the Commission to launch communication campaigns targeting diaspora communities and potential migrants with the clear message that illegal entry will not lead to permanent settlement in Europe such as Australia’s ‘No Way’ campaign;
